Name: Cocky Clint
Author: FluffyFeatherPillow
Description:
Ever played the game "Fields of Mistria"? It's another pixel farming game inspired by Stardew.
Despite still being in early access (as of this mod's release), it is ahead of Stardew in one aspect:
Its blacksmith is a HOT and MARRIAGEABLE TSUNDERE.

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]STARDEW VALLEY CAN'T FALL BEHIND.[/font]

Therefore, I hereby present:
[b][size=5][center][size=6]The Cocky Clint Mod[/size][/center][/size][/b]
This mod turns Clint from a whiny loser into a cocky chad. It replaces all of his dialogue lines, sprites, portraits, heart events and appearances in other events.
He is now romanceable and marriageable.
Clint will continue to run the blacksmith shop (on sunny Mon - Thu) after marriage but you'll get a discount.
For a detailed list of changes, see the changelogs dropdown above.


[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Installation
[/size][/font]You can install it with a mod manager by clicking the "Mod Manager" button or install it manually.

[u][size=3]Manual Installation[/size][/u]
1. Install the requirements
 - Content Patcher (and its requirement SMAPI)
 - If playing with Stardew Valley Expanded, install this additional mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT)[/url]
2. Download CockyClint mod under the 'files' tab. You most likely want to download the most recent version
3. Unzip the mod
4. Move the unzipped folder into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder

[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/font]

[size=4][u]Stardew Valley Expanded[/u][/size]

CockyClint can be played with SVE starting with CockyClint 2.0.0 but you need to install an extra dependency: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT)[/url].
You don't need to do anything else as a player.

Since SVE brings its own changes to Clint, I had to adjust/overwrite several things to make them work together.
CockyClint automatically detects if you have SVE installed and will make the following changes:

- Removes all Clint's SVE heart events
- Clint only follows a SVE schedule on Wed and Thu
- Price discount after marriage also applies to the SVE anvil sold by Clint
- Clint's special order quest to remove the railroad boulder is retained with adjusted dialogue
- Some of the CockyClint Heart Events take place at the entrance of the mines. SVE has two possible locations for that depending on the 'OriginalMinesEntrance' setting. CockyClint supports both
- Several dialogue adjustments such as Clint's community day dialogue
- Retains all of Clint's SVE gift taste additions (so no change here)


[u][size=4]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/size][/u]

This mod will overwrite Clint's portraits and sprites. To see the CockyClint portrait and sprites, go to the mod settings of Seasonal Outfits and disable the "SlightlyCuterClint" option (The settings are easily accessible if you use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).
Then go to sleep and the sprite should have changed the next day.


[size=4][u]Lucikiel[/u][/size]

Kind of compatible since 2.1.0.
Clint will have its vanilla not-cocky personality in the Lucikiel heart events and dialogues. And it will show Clint's blushing portrait instead of surprised/scared portraits in Lucikiel' content.

[s]Heart events will not trigger. However, if you want to do a small edit in the Lucikiel's mod file, you can reactivate all heart events in both mods.[/s] With Cocky Clint 2.1.0, this is not necessary anymore. You will see all heart events from both mods. However, the portrait and personality mismatch still persists.


[u][size=4]Looking for Love[/size][/u]

Compatible with CockyClint 2.1.0. However, CockyClint will remove all Clint schedules, dialogues and heart events added by Looking for Love.
Also, you need to uncheck all ClintOptions (VanillaSprite, VanillaPort, UpdateSprite, UpdatePort) to see the CockyClint sprites and portraits.


[size=4][u]Custom Kissing Mod[/u][/size]

CockyClint 2.1.0 contains a config file to make them compatible.
Caution: Beginning with CockyClint 2.1.1, the config file is a separate download and not included in the main mod anymore. This is to prevent confusing error messages when you're not using the Custom Kissing Mod.


[size=4][u]General Info on compatibility
[/u][/size]
It may clash with other mods that replaces the following:
- Clint's character dispositions (from Data/characters.json)
- Clint's portraits
- Clint's sprites
- Clint's dialogue
- Clint's schedule
- Clint's gift tastes
- Emily's 8 heart event
- Shane's 7 heart event part 2
- Unlock furnace event
- Clint's mails to to player
- The layout of these locations: blacksmith, the town area around the blacksmith, path to the mines

Depending on what the conflicting mod is doing and what the load order is, only a part of the CockyClint Mod's content might be replaced and everything else might still work. Or if the load order is in favor of CockyClint, it will just (partially) overwrite the content of the conflicting mod.

If Clint's basic character dispositions is overwritten by another mod, some features (e.g. Clint's spouse room) might not work. It depends on what is exactly overwritten.
If the clashing mod is replacing Clint's portraits and sprites, it will break all of Clint's heart events and many dialogue lines since I'm referencing custom made portraits and sprites that are most probably not present in the other mod.
If the clashing mod is replacing the layout of the above mentioned locations, some of the heart events might have weird movements at weird locations
If the clashing mod is appending (not replacing) new dialogue, schedules and gift tastes, there might be no conflict at all.
If the clashing mod is only replacing the events of Emily and Shane or the unlock furnace event, you might just see their version of the events depending on mod load order. Clint's portraits and sprites will probably be weird in those events, but nothing else should break.
